meta.title: End to End 2 of 2 - Deliver and Recover

views.label: Claim on the partition thread
views.note: Claim built, not wired (DeliveryClaimService): lock, hold check, HELD or SENDING; offset after the claim. Bulkhead permit first: not wired.

views.label: Send on the send route
views.note: Built, not wired: credential opened at send, checked address, layer-1 redelivery, outcome class, attempt row. Transform step planned.

views.label: Retry and reconcile
views.note: Re-drive code built, not wired (its job has no handler yet); reconciler and stale-claim sweeper planned (ADR-010 s9).

messages.label: full: defer, no call (not wired)
messages.note: JdbcBulkheadDeferrals (built, not wired): PENDING or DUE to RETRY_WAIT, 1 s doubling to 30 s, full jitter, BULKHEAD_FULL event, no attempt row. A successful claim resets the deferral count to 0.

messages.label: claim tx: lock, hold check, HELD or SENDING
messages.note: DeliveryClaimService: key lock, read the delivery, hold check (earlier same-key message or earlier delivery to this target not final), then HELD or SENDING with a fresh claim token

messages.label: hand over to the send route
credential: open at send (KEK by id)
messages.note: Sealed target_credential rows read in the claim's tenant; opened in memory for this call only, no cache; the KEK comes from the secret store, never the database (ADR-007 D7 rules 1, 6)

messages.label: key missing: KEY_UNAVAILABLE, no call
messages.note: TRANSIENT: SENDING to RETRY_WAIT on the claim token, no attempt row, no attempt used up; an alert fires and this instance fails its readiness check (ADR-007 D7 rule 5)

messages.label: tag mismatch: DEAD_LETTERED
messages.note: PERMANENT: reason 'target credential unreadable', an alert fires; neither ciphertext nor plaintext is logged (ADR-007 D7 rule 5)

messages.label: pinned mapping (planned)
messages.note: platform-routing has no transform dependency yet; the API adapter's body port is a stub (ApiAdapterConfiguration).

messages.label: send to checked IP, layer-1 redelivery
messages.note: ApiTargetCall: the destination guard pins the resolved IP; Camel layer 1 redelivers TRANSIENT only (2 max, 500 ms doubling, 5 s cap). Per-target breaker planned.

messages.label: HTTP status -> outcome class
messages.note: OutcomeClassifier: 400/401/403/422 PERMANENT (one attempt, dead-lettered); 429/503 TRANSIENT; 408 and other 5xx AMBIGUOUS unless the target declares idempotent receive

messages.label: attempt row, delivery_event, state (token)
messages.note: Conditional on the claim token; delivery_event per transition; DELIVERED or DEAD_LETTERED releases the next HELD same-key delivery in the same transaction (JdbcDeliveryRepository)

messages.label: due RETRY_WAIT to DUE + outbox (not wired)
messages.note: DeliveryRetryTrigger is built; the DELIVERY_RETRY db-scheduler task runs but has no handler yet, so the run is skipped. Half-open trial limit planned.

messages.label: reconcile: stale ACCEPTED, idle, HELD (planned)
messages.note: Design: re-publish messages ACCEPTED over 5 min, PENDING/DUE idle over 5 min, HELD with no blocker. No reconciler code yet.

messages.label: stale claim: 3 x timeout + 65 s (planned)
messages.note: The limit is computed in RetryPolicy; no sweeper calls it yet. Design: classed AMBIGUOUS; a late outcome with an old token writes only a LATE_OUTCOME event.

cards.title: One slow target stays alone (not wired)
items: Sends never run on the Kafka partition thread
Per-target bulkhead (1-32 sends): not wired; send breaker: planned

cards.title: Exactly two retry layers (not wired)
items: Layer 2: RETRY_WAIT rows (8 attempts, 30 s base, 1 h cap)

cards.title: Status at code main
items: Sections 1-2: code + tests exist, not wired yet (E11)
